payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of repetitive and time-consuming activities handled by Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) systems, particularly in the context of e-learning and customer support.

claims.text: IPA systems handle repetitive tasks such as answering frequently asked questions and processing student inquiries, allowing workers to focus on more complex issues.
IPA dialogue bots assist tutors by collecting necessary information from students, which reduces the time spent on repetitive inquiries.
IPA systems automate routine workflows, such as data entry and simple task execution, freeing up skilled workers for higher-value activities.
